blind_freeze.primary_reports_satisfied_precondition: Verified that both primary reviewers (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT Sol) satisfied both covered visual cohorts (Notes >= 8.0 and Settings >= 8.0) before running this bounded advisory pass.
blind_freeze.image_inspection_disclosure: In this Antigravity ACP harness, view_file/client_view_file return raw binary PNG bytes as text replacement characters rather than multimodal image attachments. All 22 stage-13 PNG files were verified on disk by SHA256, byte size, and PNG IHDR geometry (1280x900 desktop, 390x844 mobile), while visual rendering and DOM/CSS layout were inspected directly via T3 Computer Use (preview_open/preview_snapshot/preview_evaluate) on the live synthetic fixture http://127.0.0.1:18114 serving the exact embedded bundle (SHA256 764681485d4035a7b5b95e6253a418dcab1ff0315676588d8349fe0b166e4810).
blind_freeze.gemini_round3_audit_corrections: All 10 audit defects from gemini-audit.md (G1-G10) are corrected in this report: exact ky-suite-v2 weights (0.20/0.15/0.20/0.15/0.15/0.15), identical Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP arithmetic across JSON and Markdown, no false claim of missing desktop selected rail (verified inset 3px #bf3f18 box-shadow), no false claim of clipped mobile footer actions (verified scrollable y=831.5-871.5 inside scrollHeight=1130), no invented custom elements or Shadow DOM (verified native radio inputs inside fieldset.ky-appearance and .sync-dot status indicator), and accurate UTC timestamp and model ID.

verdict.scope: Scoped visual progression review of the 18 unique stage-13 captures in two separate cohorts: Notes (14 unique captures: 4 empty, 4 editor, 4 notebook-management, 2 phone page chooser; mean 8.0) and Settings / Appearance (4 unique captures: 2 desktop, 2 mobile; mean 8.1). Advisory concurrence only; not a veto and not full behavior, accessibility, or 9/10 suite acceptance.
verdict.score_basis: Separate cohort means over the 18 unique stage-13 captures using ky-suite-v2 weights and Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.1. Four workspace-* alias captures near-duplicate their corresponding editor-* captures (12 px light / 15 px dark corner antialiasing, max channel delta 4) and are excluded from cohort means.
verdict.reason: Notes (14 unique files, sum 112.4 / 14 = 8.0285714... -> 8.0) and Settings / Appearance (4 unique files, sum 32.4 / 4 = 8.10 -> 8.1) both meet the >= 8.0 visual progression bar with every unique capture scoring >= 8.0 (min 8.0, max 8.2). The 3-rule mobile CSS fix in web/src/styles.css (@media max-width: 800px) cleanly resolves the Round 9 phone Settings density/wrapping issue: the 6 section links form an even 3x2 grid (115.3x40px cells at 390px viewport), the header subtitle balances across two lines ('Your browser preferences / and account security.'), and the Appearance card starts 44px higher (y=527px vs stage-12 y=571px in scored captures; y=368.1px card top in live native inspection).

arithmetic.rounding: Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.1 for per-file weighted totals and cohort means
